```yaml
name: Update Ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Run daily at 1 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-ingestr-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Check for new Ingestr release
        id: check-release
        run: |
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'ingestrVersion = "\K[^"]+' main.go)
          if [ "$LATEST_RELEASE" != "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "New Ingestr release found: $LATEST_RELEASE"
            echo "::set-output name=new_version::$LATEST_RELEASE"
          else
            echo "No new Ingestr release found."
          fi

      - name: Create pull request if new version is found
        if: steps.check-release.outputs.new_version
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION=${{ steps.check-release.outputs.new_version }}
          git config --global user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config --global user.email github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -b update-ingestr-$NEW_VERSION
          sed -i '' "s/ingestrVersion = \"\([^"]*\)\"/ingestrVersion = \"$NEW_VERSION\"/" main.go
          git add main.go
          git commit -m "Update ingestrVersion to $NEW_VERSION"
          git push origin update-ingestr-$NEW_VERSION
          gh pr create --title "Update ingestrVersion to $NEW_VERSION" --body "Bump ingestrVersion to $NEW_VERSION" --base main --head update-ingestr-$NEW_VERSION
```
